claim_scope: One-wingbeat-ahead prediction of left-wing theta, eta, phi, and xi kinematics from completed left steering-muscle fluorescence summaries and measured wingbeat frequency in the Melis tethered-flight recordings. This protocol does not validate bilateral mechanics, force, aerodynamics, or free flight.

split.individual_identity_limit: The public artifact does not provide a reviewed session-to-animal crosswalk, so the claim is date-held-out and must never be labelled animal-held-out.

causality.availability_rule: Every fluorescence summary and frequency feature must have completed acquisition and causal preprocessing by issue time.

model_comparison.baseline: Pinned Melis CNN architecture retrained from scratch with identical causal inputs, train-only preprocessing, calibration-only fitting, validation-only selection, and frozen held-out predictions.
model_comparison.candidate: Registered virtual-hinge predictor with an immutable parameter and adapter receipt.
model_comparison.sample_identity: Candidate and baseline are evaluated on identical held-out stable sample IDs and masks.
model_comparison.null: Calibration-only coefficient mean predictor used to verify that the matched baseline is informative.

metrics.integrity: All registered exact-zero digest, split-overlap, future-reference, availability, fit-reference, model-selection, sample-mismatch, and non-finite counts must equal zero.
metrics.phase_angle_rmse: Reconstruct each target axis on the pinned phase grid, compute per-wingbeat circular angle error, aggregate within movie, session, and acquisition date without treating nested observations as independent.
metrics.coefficient_rmse: Compute the same hierarchical aggregation in the 80-coefficient representation.
metrics.acceptance: Each candidate-to-matched-baseline RMSE ratio and the matched-baseline-to-train-mean RMSE ratio must have a one-sided 95% acquisition-date-cluster bootstrap upper bound no greater than 1.0; every axis is also gated separately.
